_about: The corner crew, as plain data. Four stations; every member is a named person you have to earn, then pay by the night. speed is how fast they work their station (1 is your own pace); the corner moves at the pace of its slowest station. pop: chance a fill is wasted. tip: chance of a perfect balloon and a $1 tip. spot: chance of catching one of Officer Dan's people. turnaway: chance of refusing an honest buyer. skim: chance a dollar goes missing from a sale. care: true halves how many buyers end up needing a healer. rule names the check in life.js (EARN) that earns them; 'later' means the quest that earns them is not in the game yet.

front.name: Order-taker
front.does: takes the orders and watches for undercovers

cash.name: Cash
cash.does: bundles the money and gets it off the corner

run.name: Runner
run.does: hands the balloons out and keeps the line moving

whip.name: Whip
whip.earn: Keep him out of trouble and win the showdown with Vinny
whip.blurb: Knows tanks. Steady hands, most nights.

lostsock.name: Lost Sock
lostsock.earn: Play a set at the Open Decks tent that scores 90% or better
lostsock.blurb: Fills in time with the music. Fast, showy, pops a few.
lostsock.hired: "Four on the floor, one in the hand."

doc.name: Doc
doc.earn: Make it right with the Village Elder
doc.blurb: Reads people. Catches nearly every undercover and cuts off anyone wobbling. Slow.
doc.hired: "I say who gets one. That is the deal."

brody.name: Brody
brody.earn: Spot an undercover at your corner and wave them off, five times
brody.blurb: Was one of Officer Dan's, and no good at it. Knows every tell they have.
brody.hired: "I, uh. I know what to look for. Trust me."

ranter.name: The Conspiracy Circle Guy
ranter.blurb: Sees undercovers everywhere. Never sells to a real one; turns away one honest buyer in four.

willow.name: Willow
willow.earn: The tender-care thread of the Breakthrough quest
willow.blurb: Nobody suspects her. The Elder will.

tiny.name: Tiny
tiny.earn: Clear the debt Vinny holds over him
tiny.blurb: Vinny's old collector. Nobody robs him. A dollar goes missing now and then.

marge.name: Marge
marge.earn: Work five shifts on the stage crew
marge.blurb: The stage crew boss. Counts perfectly, every time.
marge.hired: "I have run load-outs bigger than this. Give me the tin."

deuce.name: Deuce
deuce.earn: Sell twenty balloons at your corner
deuce.blurb: Your best customer. "Two. No, one. No, two." Terrible with numbers.
deuce.hired: "I'll count it. Twice. Maybe three times."

fence.name: The Fence
fence.blurb: The cash is gone and clean by morning.

juniper.name: Juniper
juniper.earn: Help eight people who need a healer
juniper.blurb: Someone you sat with. Hands out gently and walks the shaky ones to the Chill-Out Tent.
juniper.hired: "If anyone looks rough, I'm walking them over. No arguing."

sparkle.name: Sparkle
sparkle.blurb: A kandi kid who knows everybody. The line never stops moving.

buck.name: Buck
buck.earn: One more favour for the Naked Guy
buck.blurb: Security will not go near him to search him.

carguy.name: The "Where's My Car" guy
carguy.blurb: Fast, cheerful, and wanders off whenever he remembers the car.

cedar.name: Cedar
cedar.blurb: Blesses every balloon. Slow. His buyers tip.
